label: Biological Sciences
description: Fundamental research in biology ranging from molecules to cells organisms and ecosystems including molecular and cellular biosciences integrative organismal systems and environmental biology.

label: Computer and Information Science and Engineering
description: Fundamental research in computer science artificial intelligence algorithms computing networks cyberinfrastructure cybersecurity and software engineering.

label: STEM Education
description: Research on science technology engineering and mathematics education learning environments workforce development and broadening participation in STEM.

label: Engineering
description: Designing, building and testing physical hardware and processes that do useful work. Typical subjects are mechanical and structural design, solid and fluid mechanics, heat transfer and thermodynamics, dynamics feedback and control, electronic circuits, sensors and actuators, photonic and semiconductor devices, chemical reactors separations catalysis and combustion, manufacturing and additive fabrication, earthquake-resistant structures, geotechnics, water treatment, transportation and civil infrastructure, biomechanics, tissue scaffolds and medical devices. Characterised by building and testing physical artefacts.

label: Geosciences
description: Research on the earth ocean atmospheric and geospace sciences including climate processes geology and polar research.

label: Mathematical and Physical Sciences
description: Fundamental research in mathematics astronomy physics chemistry and materials science.

label: Social Behavioral and Economic Sciences
description: Research on human behavior social organizations and cognitive psychological and economic processes including sociology linguistics and anthropology.

label: Technology Innovation and Partnerships
description: Use-inspired and translational research accelerating the development of new technologies commercialization and public-private partnerships.
